load_vertex_ai_credentials: load Vertex AI service account credentials from a JSON file and environment variables into a temporary file
create_async_vertex_embedding_task: create an async task that calls litellm aembedding with Vertex AI textembedding-gecko model and measures response time
run_load_test: run an async load test against Vertex AI embeddings with configurable duration and requests per second
analyze_results: analyze Vertex AI embedding response times and assert the median is under a performance threshold
test_embedding_performance: run a pytest async load test on Vertex AI embeddings at 20 RPS for 20 seconds
